ai_summary: Manba Finance Limited reported a robust Q1 FY26, achieving a 43% YoY increase in AUM to INR 1,415 crore and an 89% surge in Profit After Tax to INR 10 crore, driven by significant network expansion and product diversification. The company proactively tightened credit by lowering Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios and strategically paused new co-lending arrangements, aiming to enhance asset quality and leverage its strong capital position. However, a sequential decline in interest income due to rate adjustments and increased borrowing costs from higher liquidity indicate potential margin pressure, despite management targeting 30-35% AUM and PAT growth in the coming years.
